subject: Request: One-time pilot credit & timeline extension for Nimble Health
messages:
From: Olivia Grant <olivia@nimblehealth.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Mar 2027 13:12:00 -0400
Subject: Request: pilot window extension + one-time credits

Marcus,

Thanks again for the demo today — the model responses on our clinical note summarization test looked promising. We are close to getting sign-off from clinical ops, but two items came up that will block our evaluation next week:

- We burned through our free PLG allotment faster than expected because the team tested longer sequences and more iterations.
- Our procurement timeline is slipping; we expect a PO in ~3 weeks, but the internal compliance review will push out the start date for a paid contract.

Is there a way to extend the pilot window by 21 days and grant an additional one-time credit allowance (~$6k equivalent) so we can complete the clinical validation without interruption? I can loop in procurement and attach the initial SOW draft if that helps.

Attachments: nimble_poc_usage_20270325.xlsx (usage export)

Olivia Grant
Head of Clinical Innovation
Nimble Health
olivia@nimblehealth.com
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Olivia Grant <olivia@nimblehealth.com>
Date: Fri, 26 Mar 2027 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Request: pilot window extension + one-time credits

Monica / Ben — forwarding a customer ask from Nimble Health. Key points: they need +21 days on the POC and roughly $6k of extra credit to finish clinical validation. Procurement expects to finalize a PO in ~3 weeks, so they can convert to paid once procurement clears.

Monica: you're the AE on the account and have context on the exec sponsor. Ben: need your ops view — can we approve a one-time credit and what approvals are required?

Customer urgency: medium-high — they are close but blocked.

Thanks,
Marcus
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Mar 2027 08:32:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Fwd: Request: pilot window extension + one-time credits

Marcus / Monica — thanks for flagging. I pulled the usage export and ran a quick cost projection. Notes: 

- Current PLG top-up policy allows small one-off extensions up to $1k without exec review; anything >$2k requires Deal Desk approval.
- Nimble's usage profile (attached) shows heavier token consumption due to long clinical notes and multiple reruns of prompts for quality tuning.
- If we grant a $6k credit and 21-day extension, projected conversion probability goes up materially given the clinical sponsor's involvement.

Requested approvals / next steps:
1) Approval from sales leadership for one-time $6,000 credit and 21-day pilot extension.
2) Ask procurement to submit a PO draft and attach it to the HubSpot record so Finance can pre-authorize invoice flow.
3) Add a clause: credit applied only to the current sandbox/org and does not change list pricing; one-time concession.

Attached: nimble_poc_usage_20270325.xlsx (cost projection), nimble_po_draft.pdf (customer PO draft)

If Sales leadership signs off, I'll record concession in Deal Desk and mark as one-time.

—Ben
Sales Operations Manager, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Olivia Grant <olivia@nimblehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Mar 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Fwd: Request: pilot window extension + one-time credits

Thanks for the write-up, Ben. I reviewed the usage and agree this is a reasonable concession to preserve momentum with a strategic healthcare customer. Approved conditions: 

- One-time $6,000 credit to be applied to Nimble Health's pilot org; credit expires if not consumed during the 21-day extension.
- Pilot window extended by 21 calendar days from the current sandbox expiry date.
- Olivia / Procurement to provide a signed PO or written confirmation of intent to purchase within 30 days of the extension start; if not received, the credit is rescinded.
- Finance to be notified to expect a PO; concessions team to log the credit in Deal Desk (DEAL-7842).

Ben: please record the concession, add the terms to the HubSpot deal, and confirm when the credit is applied. Marcus / Monica: please relay to Olivia and Procurement and request the PO draft be uploaded to HubSpot.

Laura Bennett
VP, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com
